title: Days Credit on Over-Cap Review Amounts: Case Digest for Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
## Case digest: days credit on over-cap review amounts

Cartwise Grocery Orders adds a days credit to the over-cap amount registered for review on a line billed although the shopper recorded its product as not found. The credit is added after the missing refund standing on the order has been taken off (the remainder never below zero):

- when **at least 2 calendar days** have passed from the date of the order's completion to today and the line is **perishable**, the credit is **1.00**;
- when at least 2 calendar days have passed and the line is **not perishable**, the credit is **0.50**;
- otherwise there is none.

Days are counted in calendar days from the date part of the order's completion time to today's date; the time of day plays no part. Whether the line is perishable is read from the item class on the not-found line's billed line entry.

### Cases (all hypothetical)

**Case 1.** Completed on 10 May; today is 12 May, 2 calendar days later. The not-found line is a perishable item. Credit: 1.00. With an over-cap figure of 16.10 left after the missing refund is taken off, the figure carrying the credit is 17.10.

**Case 2.** Completed on 10 May; today is 12 May. The not-found line is a pantry item. Credit: 0.50.

**Case 3.** Completed on 10 May late in the evening; today is 11 May, 1 calendar day later. Credit: none, whatever the item class.

**Case 4.** The missing refund standing on the order exceeds the claim value, so the remainder is 0.00; 3 calendar days have passed and the line is perishable. The credit is still added to that remainder: 1.00.

| Calendar days since completion | Perishable line | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | either | none |
| 2 or more | yes | 1.00 |
| 2 or more | no | 0.50 |
